description: Structured response containing array of chat IDs for a user

success.description: Indicates if the request was successful

data.description: Array of chat objects for previous AI chats, each containing the chat ID, its associated chat type ID, and the SEO-friendly slug for URL construction

chatTypeId.description: The UUID of the chat type this chat belongs to

seoFriendlyId.description: The SEO-friendly slug from the chat type, used for constructing human-readable URLs (e.g. /ai/chat-heart-darkness/{chatId})
